semantically_equivalent_models.justification: Product-based neural networks can be semantically aligned with factorization-machine supported neural networks as both aim to incorporate interactions between different features or inputs. The factorization machine approach is known for its capability to model feature interactions, which aligns with the idea of product-based approaches in neural networks.
